content.title: $31 Tattoos & Piercings at All Saints Tattoo - Friday the 13th Special Event
content.text: FRIDAY THE 13TH TATTOO & PIERCING SPECIAL MARCH 13TH, 2026 10AM TIL 1AMAvailable at Both Locations: 1706 E. 6TH STREET AUSTIN, TX 78702 8303 BURNET RD. STE. 2 AUSTIN, TX 78757(**DOWNTOWN LOCATION HAS MOVED TO EAST SIDE! DON'T GO TO THE DIRTY 6TH ON THE 13TH!**)700 Designs all original and exclusive, we designed and drew them and are available NOWHERE else! More designs than any shop on earth! Right here in Austin Texas!644 Original & Exclusive Friday the 13th Tattoo Designs AND we have ANOTHER new sheet of flash for March 2026!NEW DESIGNS!TATTOOS $31: *$31 - JUST BLACK: BLACK OUTLINE, OR BLACK OUTLINE WITH BLACK SHADING *$40 - BLACK PLUS ONE COLOR *$50 - BLACK PLUS TWO COLORS BODY PIERCINGS $31: INCLUDES JEWELRY LOBE, HELIX, CONCH, ROOK, TRAGUS, FLAT, NOSTRIL, EYEBROW, LIP (STANDARD), MEDUSA, LABRET, ASHLEY, MONROE, TONGUE (STANDARD) & NIPPLERULES FOR FRIDAY THE 13TH: *MAX THREE TATTOOS OR THREE PIERCINGS PER SITTING You can get more but you have to go back in line again. If you are getting both tattoos and piercings just let the front person know! There is only one line for both BUT if you are getting just piercings the front people will make random call outs to the line for people getting piercings only and let them cut to the front! ​ *WALK-INS ONLY FIRST COME, FIRST SERVE There is usually a waiting line, but not always. Early and late, long line. Middle of the day, not so much. If you can come in at 3pm-5pm there's usually a shorter line! *ARMS AND LEGS ONLY No hands, fingers, palms, armpits, inside upper arm, elbows, feet, toes, below ankle, upper thigh/hip, inner thigh, knee, side of knee, knee ditch, yada yada yada you get the picture. *OUR DESIGNS ONLY There are 644 original exclusive designs to pick from. If you can't find a design, look harder! *NO CHANGES TO DESIGN Some of the Friday the 13th designs have very subtle or camouflaged 13's hidden in them. *NO CHANGES TO SIZE For reference, each sheet is about the size of an 8 1/2" by 11" piece of paper. ​ *$$CASH ONLY$$ We do NOT have an ATM anymore at either location! COME PREPARED! ​ **DESIGNS PICTURED ABOVE WITH CALENDAR DATES WILL BE UPDATED FOR CURRENT MONTH/YEAR!** All Saints Tattoo is the premiere tattoo shop for Friday the 13th tattoos in Austin Texas. ​ We have 644 different unique Friday the 13th designs to choose from. Hundreds more than anyone else. ​ All of our Friday the 13th flash is drawn and designed by us and ONLY available at All Saints Tattoo! ​ We have Friday the 13th designs made for everyone's taste! Our 600 designs are fun, bold, thin, small, some have a big "13" in the design, some 13's are subtle or hidden, you can see all of our exclusive Friday the 13th designs above! ​​​
